title: LogiStorage
description: An addon mod for Computercraft and Applied Energistics 2.
body:
LogiStorage is an addon mod for bridging automation tools between the popular mods **Computercraft** and **Applied Energistics 2**, allowing power users to build the most sophisticated and advanced automation setup at their fingertips with the power of [Lua](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lua)!

For guides and documentations on how to use this mod, please read through [here](https://github.com/bearU369/LogiStorage)!
